snippet.title: Longplay of Rocket Power: Gettin' Air
snippet.description:
Longplay of Rocket Power: Gettin' Air, played as the NTSC version on the Game Boy Color. This game's version was released on Mar. 21st, 2001. Tell us what you think by leaving a comment down below!

00:00​ - Start
01:06 - The Great Escape
02:48 - Out Of Bounds
04:32 - Showdown At The Shore
06:49 - Boogie Board Graduate
08:44 - Reggie Saves The Day
10:17 - Competition Time
12:37 - WOW, Man! Surf Like A Pro
14:23 - Sam's Sea Rescue
16:09 - Out To Impress
18:35 - WOW, Man! Surf Like A Pro
19:53 - End
20:09 - Credits

By: Terua
